outlook.statement: The outlook for Indian NBFC sector remains positive, supported by robust domestic economic growth, increasing credit demand, continued emphasis on financial inclusion, and rapid digital transformation. The Company remains focused on strengthening business fundamentals through prudent financial management, sound governance, effective risk management and strict adherence to RBI regulatory framework.

risks: Credit risk: possibility of borrowers failing to meet repayment obligations
Liquidity risk: possibility of being unable to meet financial obligations as they fall due
Interest rate risk: fluctuations in interest rates affecting borrowing cost, interest income and net interest margins
Compliance risk: financial loss, legal exposure, or reputational damage from failure to adhere to applicable statutes and regulations
Cybersecurity risk: increasing digitalization of financial services making cybersecurity and data protection critical
Need for rapid adoption of fintech solutions
Future waves of pandemic may negatively impact asset quality
Impact on demand from sustained inflation
Banks expanding aggressively into retail and MSME lending
Rising risk of cyberattacks, data breaches and digital fraud

borrowings.note: Company did not have any outstanding loans or borrowings or interest thereon due to any lender during the year
